name: noisy-neighbour
description: The analytics-export batch job starts at 13:55 on the shared database and saturates its CPU; checkout's order queries slow down and time out.

changes.detail: scheduled job analytics-export started on shopdb (owner: data-team, schedule moved from 02:00 to 13:55 last week)

log_effects.message: cpu above 90% for 60s; top consumer: analytics-export
slow query {ms}ms: SELECT ... FROM orders WHERE customer_id = ?
order lookup failed for order {id}: query timed out after 2000ms (shopdb)

ground_truth.root_cause: The analytics-export batch job started at 13:55 on the shared database, saturating its CPU and starving checkout's queries.
ground_truth.expected_action: Stop and reschedule the analytics-export job outside business hours
